bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable, linked from the restaurant's website, or by phone or email (info@arcorestaurant.com). The last tables are booked for 8:30pm.
cancellation: A deposit must be paid within three days of booking, by a payment link the restaurant sends; it is not refunded if the booking isn't used.
